Print engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume print integration covers storefront language. Xcode, entitlements, and Connect actually separate print behavior from product-page copy:

  • UIPrintInteractionController & UIPrintInfo — in-app code that presents the system print sheet and configures print jobs. Controls which content prints and how. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • UIPrinterPickerController & AirPrint routing — engineering work for printer discovery, AirPrint selection, and print-to-wireless-printer flows. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains print value to buyers.
  • Print PDF export vs AirPrint — your binary may support saving PDF to Files, sending to an AirPrint printer, or both. Listing copy should match what screenshots actually show — not promise AirPrint when the gallery only shows PDF export.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of print integration.

Working print flows in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe printing on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you implement UIPrintInteractionController or AirPrint routing.

Print listing copy is not Share sheet, Files browser, Clipboard, or Photos picker

Document and utility apps blur several surfaces indie teams conflate. AppLocale covers listing metadata only — print and AirPrint marketing on the product page:

  • Print & AirPrint (this page) — Print, AirPrint, Print to printer, Print PDF, Print this page, printer-picker sheets, and description copy about sending output to a physical printer or print-ready PDF.
  • Share sheet (different) — Share, Copy Link, Save Image, and export-to-other-apps marketing. See Share sheet listing guide — not Print to printer copy.
  • Files & document browser (different) — Open in Files, Browse documents, Import PDF, and Document picker marketing. See Files browser listing guide — saving a PDF to Files is not the same as Print or AirPrint listing copy unless your gallery frame shows the print sheet.
  • Clipboard (different) — Copy, Paste, Copy to clipboard, and Universal Clipboard marketing. See Clipboard listing guide — not print-button copy.
  • Photos picker & Camera (different) — Choose Photos, Take Photo, and camera capture marketing. See Photos picker listing and Camera listing — not AirPrint printer selection copy.
  • AirPlay (different) — cast to Apple TV, HomePod, or speakers. See AirPlay listing guide — wireless casting is not printing to paper.

Your screenshots may show multiple surfaces in one gallery. Listing copy should name the correct one per frame — a Print sheet with printer selection is not a Share action row, not an Open in Files browser, not a Copy to clipboard button, and not an AirPlay route picker.

Common mistakes on print-themed zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming print integration localizes automatically — UIPrintInteractionController shipped in the binary; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and Print/AirPrint screenshot caption lines still English
  • Conflating print with Share sheet export — listing says 分享 when the app only supports Print to printer, not UIActivityViewController flows
  • Conflating print with Files save — Save to Files belongs on the Files browser listing guide, not Print sheet frames
  • Conflating print with Clipboard — Copy to clipboard belongs on the Clipboard listing guide, not printer-picker screenshots
  • English Print to printer on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in button labels on PNG exports are still Latin
  • Expecting AppLocale to implement UIPrintInteractionController or AirPrint — print sheet configuration and printer routing are engineering tasks outside listing rewrite scope
  • What's New still English after print launch — see What's New in Simplified Chinese when AirPrint support shipped in a recent version
